name: Loom of the Untraveled Road
summary: Loom of the Untraveled Road is a Daedric apparatus hidden in the realm of Fargrave. It is accessed from a portal in the Fargrave Loom Quarter, which is part of the Fargrave Outer Ruins.
notes: It is called "Ithelia's Prison Copy" and "Loomheart" in some of the files.
